search_and_curation_notes.scope: Broad, targeted literature search spanning direct ploidy–resource studies, WGD/aneuploidy cancer biology, cell-size scaling, glucose-starvation mechanisms, alternative nutrients and tumor microenvironment, resource ecology/modeling, primary software methods, and cell-line provenance.
search_and_curation_notes.review_type: Curated narrative evidence map, not a registered systematic review, meta-analysis, or exhaustive PRISMA search.
selection_logic: Prioritized primary studies that directly manipulate or measure ploidy under resource stress.
Included authoritative reviews and foundational theory where they provide necessary framing or terminology.
Included counterexamples and opposite-direction findings to reduce confirmation bias.
Included methods and provenance papers that can support the supplied Methods section.
Retained records with access or editorial limitations only when potentially important, and marked those limitations explicitly.
search_and_curation_notes.claims_policy: Claims are concise paraphrases of the accessed material, not quotations. Each claim is anchored to supplied manuscript text or a named planned Introduction/Discussion topic and contains qualifications intended to prevent overstatement.

access_level_definitions.full_text_author_manuscript: A complete accepted/author manuscript was accessible and examined; pagination or copyediting may differ from the version of record.
access_level_definitions.full_text_pdf: A complete PDF or equivalent full-text document was accessible and examined.

access_level_definitions.abstract_plus_author_text: The abstract and substantial author/repository text were examined, but the final publisher article was incomplete.
access_level_definitions.abstract_plus_figures: The abstract plus accessible figures, captions, or result summaries were examined; complete full text was not available.
